discovery.not_for: Bypassing DRM, paywalls, logins, captchas, or access controls; calling videos.update without merging existing live snippet fields; uploading public/unlisted drafts; or reading browser profile databases/cookie stores.
discovery.setup: Python 3.11+. Exposes both legends-youtube and legends-yt-dlp entrypoints (plus legends-youtube yt-dlp|archive|pull|transcribe|clips). Offline doctor, resources, quota-plan, metadata-plan, packaging-audit, chapters-lint, quiz-lint, thumbnail-check, draft-freeze, score-idea, and 0-quota public-readback / channel-outliers require no credentials. Live Data API v3 / Analytics API v2 commands use YOUTUBE_API_KEY or OAuth 2.0 env vars; yt-dlp media pulls verify the local yt-dlp binary and ffmpeg on PATH.
